title: I’m Using The Habit
body:
My wife and I are both autistic, and we struggle with executive dysfunction. Routines are essential but we have trouble getting into and sticking to routines because how do you remember everything? We also hate demands, and typical schedules with time constraints don’t work for us. 

Enter The Habit. We can make our daily routine lists, complete with tracking of things like our steps, we can share the routines between us, and it even appears in a visually pleasing and non distracting format. 

Totally recommend this app! There’s so much more functionality to it that I have yet to discover, and I look forward to mastering it and using it for years to come.

title: Great features but slightly glitchy
body:
Love this app, it provides a great visual way to see and track how well you’re doing with habits in a variety of ways. I can tick off a daily habit, or see progress with ongoing habits such as how many minutes a week spent on a specific exercise. And it’s all really visual so I can get the satisfaction of seeing more color each week across my calendar the more I tick off each habit.

Where it falls down is in the execution. Sometimes when I go back a day to tick off or add minutes to a exercise it gets confused and only updates today’s habits, even when I’m clearly selecting an earlier date to modify. And when I want to view a weeks worth of habits, it defaults to a week ending today and at other times to a week always ending on Sunday. These aren’t glitches that are so bad to make me look for another app but they are annoying.

title: Absolutely Love it!!
body:

I like how you can set different ’units’ for a habit (can be in hours, calories, numbers in count, km or even custom etc.) and I like the variety of frequency/cycle being available unlike other habit trackers simply providing daily/weekly cycle. Also you can set multiple reminders for a particular habit which again many other habit trackers fail to do. It gives you a comprehensive chart to analyse. The system is flexible enough so you can use it for the things you want to quit rather than build a strong habit. I really think there are many distinctive features that makes this app stand out from the rest. Best of all these are completely free with no ads! I’m a huge fan of the developer’s other app called Minimalist which I highly recommend to anyone!! Thank you Dave :)
